entries.speaker: Listless-Looking Student
entries.en: Volleyball rallies are such a waste[n]of time. I'd skip it if it didn't count[n]for a grade.

entries.speaker: Tired-Looking Student
entries.en: We need it for college. Just gotta[n]tough it out for one more year,[n]then we're free.

entries.speaker: Listless-Looking Student
entries.en: I know, but it still feels useless.[n]I guess all that matters is that[n]I get into a good college, right?

entries.speaker: Upset Volleyball Player

entries.speaker: Kamoshida
